text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...I believe how I choose to wear this 
defeat is entirely up to me."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Will you let it remain a mere single loss 
on your record, or turn it into the 
springboard that propels you to your next 
victory?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If I rework even this frustration, it's 
sure to become a piece that makes me 
shine.
